annotations.title: Italian Piano Transizione 5.0 Tax Credit Calculator

description:
[Italian Piano Transizione 5.0 tax credit calculator. Deterministic calculation, read-only, side-effect free]. Simulates statutory tax credits under Piano Transizione 5.0 (Art. 38 D.L. 19/2024 & D.M. 24/07/2024) across 3 investment brackets and certified energy reduction tiers (3-15%), including high-efficiency solar PV bonuses (+12%/+14%) and eligible training expenses.
Usage: Use this tool to model corporate tax credits for energy-efficient capital goods investments under PNRR Mission 7.
Returns: JSON object with { companyName: string, isEligible: boolean, reductionTierAchieved: string, baseTaxCreditRatePercent: number, breakdown: object, effectiveBlendedSubsidyIntensityPercent: number, compensationRules: object }.

certifiedEnergyReductionPercent.description: Energy consumption reduction percentage certified by an ENEA-accredited auditor

dnshCriteriaMet.description: Whether investment strictly complies with Do No Significant Harm (DNSH) environmental principles

photovoltaicInvestmentEur.description: Optional investment in self-generation renewable solar PV assets in EUR

pvModuleClass.description: ENEA register efficiency class for solar modules (D.L. 181/2023)

reductionScope.description: Energy savings perimeter: enterprise structure (min 3%) or production process (min 5%)

totalInvestmentCapitalGoods40Eur.description: Eligible investment in Industry 4.0 capital goods (Annex A & B) in EUR

trainingCostsEur.description: Workforce training expenditure in green/digital skills (capped at 10% of investment up to €300k)
